sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We may issue and sell shares of our common stock having aggregate sales proceeds of up to $42,500,000 from time to time. The amount of
proceeds from this offering will depend upon the number of shares of our common stock sold and the market price at which they are sold. Because there is no minimum offering amount required as a condition of this offering, the actual total offering
amount, commissions and proceeds to us, if any, are not determinable at this time. There can be no assurance that we will be able to sell any shares under the sales agreement with the Sales Agent as a source of financing.
